Strings.firewall.login_required: Sign in to a RelaxKonOS Server to manage its firewall.
Strings.firewall.warning: Firewall changes can disconnect this RelaxKonOS session. Confirm your management access before applying a rule.
Strings.firewall.password_dialog.title: Confirm firewall change
Strings.firewall.password_dialog.message: This operation changes the host firewall. Enter the current signed-in account password to continue.
Strings.firewall.rule.help: Select a rule, then choose Update to edit it. Leave source, destination, or port blank for any; use a single port or a range such as 443 or 8000:8080.
Strings.firewall.rule.source_tooltip: Enter the client source address to match. Leave blank for any, or enter an IP or CIDR such as 192.0.2.10, 192.0.2.0/24, or 2001:db8::/32.
Strings.firewall.rule.destination_tooltip: Enter the host destination address to match. Leave blank for any, or enter an IP or CIDR such as 192.0.2.10, 192.0.2.0/24, or 2001:db8::/32.
Strings.firewall.validation.address_invalid: Source and destination must be any or a valid IP/CIDR, such as 192.0.2.10 or 2001:db8::/32.
Strings.firewall.validation.port_invalid: Enter a port from 1 to 65535, or a start:end range.
Strings.firewall.permission.read_required: Firewall access requires the Read firewall configuration permission.
Strings.firewall.permission.manage_required: Changing the firewall requires the Manage firewall configuration permission.
